# Ball Always Somewhere

## Statement

Players and coaches must always be able to answer "where is the ball?" — possession is never ambiguous, duplicated, or lost.

## Who Feels It

The player reading the field; the coach reviewing a practice run. Ambiguous possession makes every downstream judgment (positioning, passing, scoring) meaningless.

## Evidence

Domain-given: the sport has exactly one ball. Playtests with double-possession bugs were reported as "broken" within seconds — this is the fastest-noticed failure class in the game.
